card.name: Ends of acronyms like DDT, BBS
card.fires_on: The last letters of capitalized acronyms such as DDT, BBS (Bardet-Biedl syndrome) and NST. It also fires on a few words like 'while' and 'time' inside set phrases (all the while, at one time).
